title.en: Not going out of a region

statement.en: Nothing in a region goes out of it along a relation exactly where what is not outside it is closed under the relation, as a closed region is; the two are one where membership is settled. Where each step keeps to the region or leaves it, a line from inside to outside has a step out, placed on it.
statement.zh: 一域沿一关系不出，恰是不外于域者在此关系下闭，闭之域即然；凡不外者皆内处二者为一。每步或守于域或出之，则自内至外之线上有一出步，定其所在。

laws.en: Nothing in a region goes out of it along a relation where no member bears the relation to something outside. A closed region is not gone out of, an occurrence's closure among them; not going out is exactly the closedness of what is not outside the region, with no decision; and where whatever is not outside lies inside, not going out is being closed.
laws.zh: 一域沿一关系不出，谓无一员以此关系及于域外者。闭之域不出，一发生之所闭亦然；不出恰是不外于域者之闭，不用判定；凡不外者皆内处，不出即闭。
declarations: Becoming.«不出当且仅当不外者闭»
Becoming.«不外者内则不出当且仅当闭»

laws.en: Calibration. That every region nothing goes out of is closed, for every carrier, relation and region, is exactly excluded middle: what a member bears the relation to is not outside the region, and is shown inside only where membership there is settled.
laws.zh: 校准：于每一载体、关系与域，凡不出之域皆闭，恰是排中：员以此关系所及者不外于域，唯其属与否已定处方见其在内。
declarations: Becoming.«不出皆闭当且仅当排中»

laws.en: Nothing comes into a region along a relation, nothing outside bearing it to a member, exactly where nothing goes out of what lies outside the region, with no decision. Along a symmetric relation nothing goes out of a region exactly where nothing comes in; along one that is not, a closed region can be come into.
laws.zh: 无物沿一关系入一域（无域外者以之及于员），恰是域外者不出，不用判定。关系对称时，不出恰是不入；不对称时，闭之域犹可入。
declarations: Becoming.«逆之不出当且仅当外者不出»
Becoming.«对称则不出当且仅当逆不出»

laws.en: A line of continuation under any class from a member of a region to something outside it means something in the region bears the relation to something outside, with no decision.
laws.zh: 任一类下自域之一员至域外者之续线，即域中有物以此关系及于域外，不用判定。

laws.en: Where every step of continuation from a member keeps to the region or goes out of it, such a line has a step going out, from a member to something outside, reached from the start and reaching the end: the mark law, with keeping to the region as what the ends fail. Where membership is decided every step is of one kind or the other.
laws.zh: 自员之每步续或守于域或出之，则此线上有一出步，自员至域外者，自始可及，可及其终：即两端分则中有标之律，以守于域为两端所不合者。属与否已判定处，每步皆为二者之一。
declarations: Becoming.«定则内至外之线有出步»

laws.en: The World's cut, a region of a valuation's events that no formed relation leaves, is not going out along the valuation's relation, by definition. So a region closed under the relation is a cut, and a cut is closed where membership is settled.
laws.zh: 世界的切口（一赋值之事件中无已形成之关系离开之域），依定义即此赋值之关系下之不出。故于此关系下闭之域是切口，凡不外者皆内处切口即闭。

hypotheses.en: No axiom: every cited declaration has an empty axiom report, in core modules held to the core's conditions (Lean's prelude only).
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理：所引每项声明的公理报告皆空，所在模块属核心，守核心之条件（仅用 Lean 前奏）。

hypotheses.en: Any carrier, any relation and any region given by a Prop-valued predicate; a line is a finite chain of steps of continuation (相续) under any class, the relation met with the class.
hypotheses.zh: 任意载体、任意关系，及以取 Prop 值之谓词给出之任意域；线是任一类下有限步之续（相续），续即关系与类之合。

hypotheses.en: «不外者内则不出当且仅当闭» and Flow.closedUnder_of_cut take as a hypothesis that whatever is not outside the region lies in it; «内至外之线有出步» that every step of continuation from a member keeps to the region or goes out of it; «定则内至外之线有出步» that membership is decided; «对称则不出当且仅当逆不出» that the relation is symmetric.
hypotheses.zh: «不外者内则不出当且仅当闭» 与 Flow.closedUnder_of_cut 以凡不外者皆内为假设；«内至外之线有出步» 以自员之每步续或守于域或出之为假设；«定则内至外之线有出步» 以属与否已判定为假设；«对称则不出当且仅当逆不出» 以关系对称为假设。

hypotheses.en: The calibration quantifies over every carrier in the lowest universe; its witness has two occurrences.
hypotheses.zh: 校准对最低宇宙层级之每一载体量化；其见证只有二发生。

does_not_show.en: That a region nothing goes out of is closed: where membership is not settled, what a member bears the relation to is only not outside.
does_not_show.zh: 不出之域闭：属与否未定时，员所及者只是不外于域。
does_not_show.witness: Becoming.«不出皆闭当且仅当排中»

does_not_show.en: That a closed region is not come into: along a relation that is not symmetric, something outside can bear it to a member.
does_not_show.zh: 闭之域无物可入：关系不对称时，域外者可以之及于员。

does_not_show.en: Where on a line its step going out lies, when not every step keeps to the region or goes out of it: then only that something in the region bears the relation outside.
does_not_show.zh: 非每步皆守或出时，线上之出步在何处：此时只得域中有物以此关系及于域外。

does_not_show.en: A graded boundary, or which relation a self's boundary is drawn along: the laws hold for any region and relation and choose neither.
does_not_show.zh: 有等级之边界，或自身之边界沿何关系划：诸律于任意域与关系成立，二者皆不择。

detail.en: The calibration's witness: two occurrences, the relation from the first to the second, and the region of the first or a proposition S. Where ¬¬S is given nothing goes out of the region, and its being closed gives S.
detail.zh: 校准之见证：二发生，自前者至后者之关系，与「为前者或命题 S 成立」之域。已给 ¬¬S 时此域不出，而其闭即得 S。

detail.en: A closed region come into («闭而有入»): the same relation, the region of the second occurrence; it is closed, and the first, outside it, bears the relation to the second.
detail.zh: 可入之闭域（«闭而有入»）：同一关系，后一发生之域；此域闭，而在外之前者以此关系及于后者。

next_delta.en: State a graded boundary on the grammar: nested regions along one relation, the steps by which one line goes out of each, and how they lie along it.
next_delta.zh: 在文法上陈述有等级之边界：沿一关系之相套诸域，一线出每一域之步，及其在线上之次第。

correspondence.en: In graph terms a region nothing goes out of has no edge leaving it, and a closed region holds every successor of its members. Classically the two are one; constructively the first is the closedness of the region's double negation, they coincide on stable regions, and that they coincide on all is excluded middle. A line from inside to outside crossing a leaving edge is a discrete intermediate value property, the mark law read on a region. That the calibration says a boundary drawn where membership is undecided leaves open where what a member bears the relation to lies is the AI's reading.
correspondence.zh: 以图论言，不出之域无出边，闭之域含其员之每一后继。经典逻辑中二者为一；构造地，前者即域之双重否定之闭，二者于稳定之域上合一，于一切域上合一恰为排中。自内至外之线越一出边，是离散之介值性质，即两端分则中有标之律读于一域。把校准读作：于属与否未定处所划之边界，员所及者在何处尚未定，是 AI 的读法。

detail.zh: «续»、«相续»、«及»、«逆»、«则»、«相续含于及» 与两端分则中有标之律 «两端分则中有标»。

detail.en: Its cut, read here as not going out by definition; its sixth law reads the crossing on a self's boundaries through Flow.cut_of_closedUnder.
detail.zh: 其切口，此处依定义读作不出；其第六律经 Flow.cut_of_closedUnder 把穿越读于自身之边界。

detail.en: Its «所经必同» is proved from «定则内至外之线有出步»: the line's step going out of the region lands in the set.
detail.zh: 其 «所经必同» 由 «定则内至外之线有出步» 证得：线出域之步落于该集。

detail.en: The closures under a relation are its least closed regions, the boundaries along it, each not gone out of.
detail.zh: 一关系下之诸所闭是其最小之闭域，即沿之之边界，皆不出。

detail.en: Another calibration by a classical principle: refuting every separation refutes only being unreached, as not going out gives only what is not outside.
detail.zh: 另一项经典原则之校准：否证每种分开只否证不可及，犹不出只得不外于域者。
